t: This is the Sheraton Park Tower, a luxury five-star hotel at 101 Knightsbridge, close to Hyde Park. It was designed by Richard Seifert, the Swiss-British architect best known for the NatWest Tower, once the tallest building in the United Kingdom, and for Centre Point. The hotel was later owned by Mahdi Al Tajir, an Emirati businessman who served as the first United Arab Emirates ambassador to Britain. He also owns the Highland Spring bottled water company.
